criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Six of nine frames carry a picture made for their sentence (3 strongest, 2, 5, 6, 7); 8 generic exterior with capsule parents; 9 binder reads as a lamp and the room as a courtroom; 6 shows about 14 of 42; 2 dead lower third; 4 near twin of 2.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Spine holds, order runs; bus yellow on 8 near the accent; 1 hot magenta slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces with attribution; one advocacy article, survey instrument never found; slide 6 headline drops 'some form of', dek restores it.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Clear finding; no decider, body, place or deadline; 'ask your district' without whom, where or when.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 4 a real turn, close gives an action; 8 a side beat; cover dek front-loads 86.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean; deks mechanical, drawn to illustrate on seven slides; no regional texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh palette; unit-count device repeats nos. 75 to 77; empty chair in a hearing room echoes no. 74.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Generic school exterior with a cropped bus and small capsule parents explains nothing about voters and privacy; bus yellow competes with amber.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A counted or measured image of the claim, or a close-up of a student device with a privacy lock; drop the bus yellow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Binder reads as a lamp at thumb size; room reads as a courtroom.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera down the aisle, a district seal or nameplates and a trustees' table, binder 3x larger, open under the key.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Only about 14 binders visible; Texas gap narrow and partly hidden by the pill.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back and raise so all 42 run across with a wide lit slot; pill above the slot.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Dead lower third under the headline; near twin of 4.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the camera so the nearest desks run large into the bottom edge.
